Definition: hence, an acre (i.e. day's task for a yoke of cattle to plough)
BiblicalUsage: 1) couple, pair, team, yoke; 1a) couple, pair, span (usually of animals); 1b) acre; 1b1) the amount of land a span of oxen could plow in one day
